label: preparing
what: A confidential committee-supplies arrangement was being prepared, apparently associated with the private bread order for the jubilee; the record does not establish the exact plan or intended use. The mayor was not told the substance of the arrangement, although the mayor heard that it concerned committee supplies and was being kept private until day 1 at 18:00. The innkeeper knowingly facilitated related logistics (bread collected from the baker, debt deferred until after the jubilee, and accompaniment to the hall), but the record does not prove the innkeeper knew the committee plan's details. The baker supplied bread on the private order, but evidence does not show the baker knowingly helped with the undisclosed committee preparation.
